Step 5 of 5

The agreement

Please read this before you finish.

What you earn

You earn commission on the product value of every order placed through your site, before shipping and tax. Your rate is shown in your dashboard. A customer who arrives through your link is credited to you for 30 days, so a sale made days later still counts.

When you are paid

Commission is earned once an order is paid for and not refunded. A refunded order earns nothing. Payouts are recorded in your dashboard so you can see what has been paid and what is still owed.

Your site

The site is yours to run. You may not present it as being operated by anyone other than yourself, and you may not use the Models Boutique name to imply ownership of the business. You are responsible for anything you add to it.

What we do

We hold the stock, take the payments, ship the orders and handle returns and customer service. Product photographs and descriptions are provided for you to use on your site while you are an active affiliate.

Ending it

Either of us may end this at any time. Commission already earned on settled orders is still paid. Accounts may be closed for misrepresenting the business, for fraudulent orders, or for using the brand in ways that damage it.

Your details

We keep your name, address, contact details and ID in order to run your account and pay you. Your ID is never published and is not shared except where the law requires it.
